question: How is Kṛṣṇa's repeated performance of the mātṛkā practice across ages presented?
premises: Kṛṣṇa, lord of Dvārakā, is named as the agent.
He is said to have performed the practice.
This performance is repeated in age after age.
inference: Even Kṛṣṇa performed this mātṛkā practice in every age.
uncertainties: The feminine object 'yāṃ' likely refers to mātṛkā or mātṛkā-nyāsa supplied from context.
plain_english: Kṛṣṇa, the lord of Dvārakā, having performed it even age after age.
